def blobcenters():
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    out={}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['pixels']==20 and n['color'] in ('O','p'):
            # center = mean of bbox of boundary points
            b=n['boundary']
            rs=[p[0] for p in b]; cs=[p[1] for p in b]
            out[n['color']]=( (min(rs)+max(rs))//2, (min(cs)+max(cs))//2 )
    return out
plan = [((48,54),(12,24),(39,42)),((26,59),(12,24),(28,44)),((30,30),(12,24),(28,44)),
        ((10,55),(12,24),(18,57)),((9,49),(12,24),(18,57)),((33,37),(20,20),(18,57)),
        ((6,17),(20,20),(18,57)),((59,45),(37,30),(18,57)),((21,8),(37,30),(18,57)),
        ((61,38),(51,40),(18,57))]
print('start', blobcenters())
for i,((r,c),eA,eB) in enumerate(plan):
    res = action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    bc = blobcenters()
    A = bc.get('O'); B = bc.get('p')
    flag = 'OK' if (A==eA and B==eB) else 'MISMATCH exp %s,%s'%(eA,eB)
    print(i+1,(r,c),'noop' if res.get('no_op') else '', 'lvl' if res.get('level_completed') else '',
          'over' if res.get('game_over') else '', 'A',A,'B',B, flag)
    if res.get('level_completed') or res.get('game_over') or res.get('no_op'): break
